# BAD-021 — Publish the reconciled App Privacy label to App Store Connect after iOS 1.0 is approved

## Brief
Follow-up to BAD-006, which closed with the reconciliation shipped in PR https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/336 (1511e97) but the live store label untouched.

The live iOS App Privacy label in App Store Connect (published around 2026-09-09) still over-declares and mis-links. docs/MOBILE-STORES.md § B3 now holds the reconciled table and says how the live label differs; § A1 and site/privacy.html match it. Eric's decisions (2026-09-14):
- Declare the account's activity log as Product Interaction, Linked to You, for Analytics and App Functionality.
- Coarse Location (the IP-derived geo stamp) has the purpose Analytics.
- Keep the marketing opt-in default, which the policy now states.

Work, once iOS 1.0 is approved (not before: only the tracking answer changed for the 1.0 resubmission):
1. Re-read § B3 against main in case anything moved since PR 336.
2. List every change from the live label to § B3, type by type: what to add, remove, relink, or re-purpose.
3. Eric makes the changes in App Store Connect and approves each Publish. Nothing is published without him.
4. Afterwards, update § B3's "how the live label differs" note to say they now match, in a PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
Store console work with no code: Eric approves and clicks each Publish, so at most a scout to diff the live label against § B3 first.
